This vintage and modern writing and sealing set includes a boxed NVIZIO Sunlight Pen Collection with multiple black and gold pens, a Bradley gold-tone ballpoint pen in original case, and a Parker Classic stainless steel pen in presentation box. Also included is a wooden pen box with inkwell section, a vintage wood-handled dip pen, and a boxed metal ruler or caliper. Items are in good to very good condition, suitable for collectors or calligraphy enthusiasts.

Description
: Bring creativity and nostalgia together with this Vintage Magic Circus Coloring Kit. The set includes a charming original box, a full set of vibrant colored pens, and a series of whimsical circus-themed coloring cards featuring clowns, animals, and performers. Each card offers intricate line art for hours of coloring fun and imaginative play. The unique kit features a magic white pen allowing children to transform their finished artwork with a magical color-changing effect, adding an extra surprise with every design. The box measures approximately 7.5 inches square, making it easy to store and transport, while the included pens are conveniently organized in a pouch. Perfect for collectors, circus enthusiasts, or anyone seeking an engaging activity for children. Enjoy a timeless, analog art experience backed by vintage appeal and the authentic charm of a classic craft kit. This set is pre-owned, so some of the pictures are already colored. There are many more sheets to color though! The pens don't work very well anymore, as to be expected. Let's Get Coloring!
